title: Honestli — Digital Verification
description: A freelance Android app that fights misinformation: a CameraX-based camera for verifiable photos and videos, secured with SSL pinning and on-device encryption.
overview: Honestli is a freelance Android project built to fight misinformation. People capture photos and videos that can be verified later as tamper-proof Digital Originals.

I built the Android app: a CameraX-based camera, secure sharing of verified content with newsrooms, and the app's security layer with SSL pinning and on-device encryption backed by the Android Keystore. Provenance and verification run on the backend.

features.title: CameraX camera
features.description: A custom camera built on CameraX for capturing the photos and videos that become Digital Originals.

features.title: Security
features.description: SSL pinning against man-in-the-middle attacks, and user data encrypted on the device with keys in the Android Keystore.

features.title: Share with newsrooms
features.description: Send verified photos and videos straight to newsrooms, securely and without giving up privacy.

title: Cariboo — Car Management
description: My own car-management app on Google Play: 50+ screens built solo with agentic development (Claude Code), a Supabase backend and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
overview: Cariboo is an offline-first Android app for everything that comes with owning a car: fuel, expenses, maintenance and paperwork, for one car or a whole household's.

I built and shipped it solo, alongside full-time work: 50+ screens, 400+ commits over 10 months, now at version 1.2 on Google Play, in English and Greek. It's agentic development in practice: I implemented it with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, and created the screen designs and animations in Claude Design. Under the hood it's offline-first with Room, Hilt and WorkManager, with a Supabase backend for accounts and cloud sync, and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that builds and publishes signed releases.

features.title: Fuel tracking
features.description: Log refills with cost, litres and odometer. Consumption (L/100km) and price per litre are calculated automatically, with optional GPS location.

features.title: Expenses & services
features.description: Track services, repairs, insurance, parking, tolls and your own categories, with full history and filters.

features.title: Service reminders
features.description: Date or mileage reminders that notify you a day before the due date or within 500 km of the target.

features.title: Statistics & charts
features.description: Interactive charts for cost, distance, consumption and refills, plus year-to-year and car-to-car comparisons.

features.title: Forecasts & insights
features.description: Forecasts fuel cost per km and efficiency with Holt's linear smoothing, and flags unusual expenses.

features.title: Voice entry
features.description: Add a refill just by saying it. Speech is turned into structured data with OpenAI GPT.

features.title: Multiple cars & documents
features.description: Keep insurance, inspection (KTEO) and tyre details for every car, and attach PDFs or photos to each one.

features.title: Cloud account & sync
features.description: Sign in to back up and sync your data, powered by Supabase Auth and Edge Functions for sign-up, password reset and push notifications.

features.title: Widgets, backup & themes
features.description: Home-screen widgets for quick entry, JSON and Excel/CSV import/export, and 30+ colour palettes.
